description:
Mirror of the UNICEF Children's Climate Risk Report 2026 dataset (Global Child Hazard Database) as published by UNICEF Data and Analytics on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (dataset children-climate-risk): national-level estimates of children under 18 exposed to ten climate and climate-sensitive hazards (riverine and coastal floods, droughts, tropical storms, heatwaves, extreme heat, fires, sand and dust storms, air pollution, malaria), multi-hazard counts and intensity, overlapping hazard combinations and child vulnerability indicators for 261 countries and territories. Published as a GeoParquet layer joined to Natural Earth country polygons, a tabular Parquet with all 261 rows, and the long-format overlapping-hazards table. All exposure figures are modelled estimates (WorldPop 2024 child population overlaid on global hazard layers), not observations. Source retrieved 2026-09-23; country geometry Natural Earth Admin 0 map units 1:10m v5.1.1 (public domain). Column meanings, quirks and tested queries are in the generated AGENTS.md of each Collection.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
